notes: Crisp can now be asked to finish sooner. Max is the generative restore lane, and what it costs is output pixels — so it now offers Best detail, or Faster at about 5% less detail, which measured 1.72 times quicker on the same clip. Crisp also tells you when it is running from its disk image and therefore cannot install its own updates, and the disk image now shows you where to drag the app.
